turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! First, one example from me.
She eats an apple. Why an? The word "apple" starts with a vowel sound.
The rule is short: an before a vowel sound, a before other sounds.
This sentence is right: I have a pen. This sentence is wrong: I have an pen.

Now you. Write one word only:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
